NewOrbit develops Ultra Low Earth Orbit (ULEO) satellites that fly only 180 km above the Earth's surface, less than a third of the altitude of conventional satellites. Straddling the edge of the Earth's atmosphere enables significantly higher resolution imaging, disruptive space-based mobile networks and other game-changing applications.

Reconnect is a platform that leverages software, hardware, and data to improve outcomes and provide ongoing support during pretrial, reentry, and recovery. Reconnect has reimagined monitoring and communication for pretrial, probation and parole from the ground up, working closely with agency partners from California to Maine and enabling lower costs, more humane hardware, better connections with defendants, and lower recidivism.

Snappr is the one-stop-shop for visual content creation. Snappr’s offerings include a self-service application to book photographers, a SaaS product for enterprises to automate visual content pipelines, and an AI portrait photo-analysis tool, which integrates into tech stacks and workflows.

Steady Energy is working to introduce zero-emission heating plants to the market by 2030. At the core of the solution lies the LDR-50 nuclear reactor, which operates at low temperatures and pressures, ensuring investable, safe, and emission-free heat production.

Superhuman is the fastest email experience ever made, with advanced features, such as Superhuman AI, that give you communication superpowers. Superhuman AI can transform a few phrases into full emails to match your voice and tone, reply in an instant, polish your writing, summarize long conversations, edit, and translate. Superhuman was acquired by Grammarly in 2025.

Treeswift is building the next generation of forest monitoring systems.

UNDO develops pioneering carbon removal that can capture huge amounts of CO2 from our atmosphere. These innovative, nature-based technologies lock away carbon permanently and start immediately. With cutting-edge, scientific research, UNDO technology is safe, effective, and beneficial, whilst measuring the amount of carbon removed. Partnering with local agricultural communities enables them to both support and benefit from UNDO's work. And by providing high-quality carbon credits, UNDO enables companies to meet their net zero commitments and helps individuals who want to make a difference. UNDO's ambition is to be the first company to remove 1 million tons of CO2 with the aim of removing a billion - once and for all.
xFuel is replacing oil-based road, marine and aviation fuels with a new advanced biofuel.
